blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Rosedale

items.t: Rosedale is an unincorporated community east of Chilliwack in FVRD Electoral Area D; the FVRD places its Cheam Lake Wetlands Regional Park (53480 Elgey Road, Rosedale) in Electoral Area D and states it governs its eight electoral areas.
Street-level boundary for Rosedale as a search area: Not verified — no FVRD or board source opened publishes one, and no electoral-area boundary is substituted.
Which FVRD OCP and zoning bylaw, by number, govern a specific Rosedale parcel: Not verified — no FVRD planning bylaw for Area D was opened.

Transit: BC Transit Route 71 (Agassiz–Harrison) runs along Yale Road through Rosedale, with timepoints at Yale Road at McGrath Road and Highway 9 at Yale Road, per BC Transit's Rider's Guide (effective June 28, 2026).
School in Rosedale itself, Ministry-listed: Rosedale Traditional Community, 50850 Yale Rd, Rosedale, V0X 1X2 (SD33, Elementary).

blocks.text: Local rules that affect park-home buyers in Rosedale

items.t: Jurisdiction / taxes: Rosedale parcels are unincorporated (FVRD Area D): the rural property-tax regime under the Taxation (Rural Area) Act s.11 applies — 5% penalty after Jul 2 and a further 5% after Oct 31 — DISTINCT from the City of Chilliwack schedule (5% Jul 2 + 5% Aug 4, 2026, which does NOT apply here) and DISTINCT from Mission's flat 10% penalty (which is expressly NOT applied to rural ground). Parcel-level notice/due-date detail beyond that regime: confirm with the Province/FVRD for the specific parcel.

blocks.text: Good to know about Rosedale

items.t: The mailing shorthand misleads: "Rosedale, Chilliwack" addresses sit in FVRD Area D — a buyer who diligence-checks City of Chilliwack bylaws for a Rosedale parcel is checking the wrong government.
Cheam Lake Wetlands Regional Park (107 ha, 53480 Elgey Road) is an FVRD park in Area D, open 7 a.m. to sunset, pets not permitted under FVRD Bylaw No. 1500, 2018.

blocks.text: Duplexes and half duplexes in Rosedale
Local rules that affect duplexes in Rosedale

items.t: The SSMUH position for a specific Rosedale parcel is not confirmed until read in the fvrd's own instruments for that parcel.

Secondary suites inside a duplex — no borrowed cap: The one suite position that IS sourced for Rosedale parcels is the ALR one: On an ALR parcel, a secondary suite is permitted only within the principal residence (next bullet). A non-ALR Rosedale parcel's suite rule is not confirmed until read in the governing fvrd instruments.

ALR: Any Rosedale parcel in the Agricultural Land Reserve follows the ALC housing frame — one principal residence at a maximum total floor area of 500 m², a secondary suite only within the principal residence, and at most one additional residence of up to 90 m² on properties 40 ha or less or up to 186 m² on properties over 40 ha. Whether a specific Rosedale parcel is in the ALR is not verified at parcel level.

blocks.text: Rosedale Homes: streets and boundaries

items.t: Rosedale Traditional Community School, at 50850 Yale Road, is the named landmark on the main corridor through Rosedale.
East of Rosedale the Yale Road corridor continues into FVRD Electoral Area D (Popkum/Bridal Falls), so a "Rosedale" search can cross a municipal boundary — verify the taxing authority by address.

blocks.text: Rosedale Homes: the housing stock

items.t: The former Minter Gardens site, at the foot of Mount Cheam in the Rosedale/Popkum area, is not part of the current housing stock as an operating garden; it closed in 2013.

blocks.text: Rosedale Homes: rules that affect buyers

items.t: As a City of Chilliwack area, Rosedale is under the 2050 Official Community Plan (OCP), Bylaw 2025, No. 5500, whose Schedule B includes the Agricultural Area Plan as B1 — relevant to Rosedale's farm-edge lots.
Farm home plate rules apply on valley-floor farmland: Development Permit Area D-4, Farm Home Plate, in the 2050 OCP governs clustering residential buildings so the balance stays in farm use.

blocks.text: Rosedale Homes: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Cheam Elementary's catchment is being split between Little Mountain Elementary, Strathcona Elementary and the new east-side elementary school under the May 2026 SD33 decision — McSween/Yale Road East families should check their exact address.
SD33 also approved moving Early French Immersion from Cheam Elementary to the new east-side elementary school.
Mount Cheam Christian School, a Kindergarten-Grade 12 independent school at 48988 Yale Road East, is listed in the Province's SD33-area school list — a non-SD33 option on the Rosedale corridor.
City curbside fees in 2026 range from $27.15 to $34.80 per month by cart size, including weekly compostables and bi-weekly garbage and recycling.
Cheam Lake Wetlands Regional Park, at 53480 Elgey Road on the Rosedale/Popkum edge, prohibits pets to protect its wetland ecosystem.

blocks.text: Rosedale Homes: development and new projects

items.t: The new east-side elementary school opening September 2027, named in SD33's May 2026 decision, is the confirmed project affecting Rosedale families; its street address was not stated in the release read.

blocks.text: Rosedale Homes: costs and taxes

items.t: The City of Chilliwack is a designated taxable area for the Speculation and Vacancy Tax (SVT); a Rosedale home inside the city is in that list, while a Popkum home in Electoral Area D is not named — check the provincial map by address.

blocks.text: Rosedale Homes: getting around

items.t: BC Transit route 71, Agassiz-Harrison, runs along Yale Road through Rosedale between downtown Chilliwack and Harrison Hot Springs, and is the main bus serving Rosedale homes.
Highway 9, reached east on Yale Road, crosses the Fraser River to Agassiz and connects to Highway 1 at Bridal Falls.
Route 66, Fraser Valley Express, is the regional connection from Chilliwack toward Lougheed Station — Rosedale riders first use route 71 or drive into Chilliwack.

blocks.text: Rosedale Homes: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check floodplain status per lot: the City's Floodplain Regulation Bylaw 2018, No. 4519 requires habitable floors at or above the flood construction level plus 0.6 metres freeboard in standard-dike areas.
Check ALR status and farm home plate siting before planning a second dwelling on a farm-edge Rosedale lot.
Confirm which side of the City/FVRD boundary a listing address falls on, because tax, utility billing and subdivision authority change at that line.

blocks.text: Rosedale home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

16 houses sold in Rosedale with a median price of $1,092,450 (the middle half sold between $902,500 and $1,487,250), taking a median of 29 days to sell at 97.5% of the last list price; 6% sold above list. They had a median $412 per square foot, a median year built of 1998 and a median lot of 9,603 square feet.
